signals.headline: UpSmith raises $10M Series A led by SemperVirens
signals.quote: Dallas-based UpSmith raised a $10 million Series A round to expand its engineering and sales teams and ramp up partnerships.
signals.how_to_use: Congratulate Wyatt on closing the Series A and position Corgi's Series A package (D&O and Crime) to meet standard investor governance covenants.
signals.found_by: Looks up the company's Form D filings, which are due within 15 days of a first sale, and searches news for the round announcement.
signals.why_it_matters: Investors commonly require D&O within 60 to 90 days of close, and new board seats mean new personal liability.
signals.angle: Investors commonly require D&O within 60 to 90 days of close. Ask whether D&O is already in place for the new board.

signals.headline: Allison Baum Gates and Rob Biederman join UpSmith's board of directors
signals.quote: SemperVirens General Partner Allison Baum Gates and Rob Biederman, managing partner at Asymmetric Capital Partners, are joining UpSmith’s board.
signals.how_to_use: Highlight the addition of institutional board representatives as an immediate prompt to review and institute dedicated D&O indemnification limits.
signals.why_it_matters: A new director carries personal liability and often asks for D&O before joining.
signals.angle: New directors ask about D&O. Ask whether the policy was reviewed when the board changed.

signals.headline: Austen Wise started as Head of Sales in Sep 2026
signals.maps_to: New finance, legal, people or security lead
signals.how_to_use: Background: recently joined. Not a reason to pitch insurance on its own.
signals.found_by: Finds each top contact's public profile and reads the start date of their current role. Searches news for appointment announcements.
signals.why_it_matters: New leaders review the vendors they inherit in their first months, and insurance sits with exactly these roles.
signals.angle: New leaders review what they inherit. Ask what the insurance setup looks like, without congratulating them on a job you only read about.
